quiz_management.TITLE: Quiz Management
quiz_management.HELP_PURPOSE_DESC: This function allows you to manage quizzes used in rooms.
HELP_PERMISSIONS_LIST: Create new quizzes with multiple questions and options.
HELP_USAGE_STEPS: Click "Add Quiz" to create a new quiz.
Enter the topic (subject) of the quiz.
Enter the question, options, and mark the correct answer.
Click "Add Quiz" to save or "Update Quiz" to update.
Use the "Edit" button to edit or "Delete" to remove the quiz.
quiz_management.HELP_NOTE_DESC: Quizzes will be used in corresponding rooms for users to answer.

team.heading: Meet Our Creative Team
team.subHeading: We are Virtual Meet, a project group consisting of 5 members from FPT University. With a passion for technology and a desire to enhance online experiences, our team has developed a virtual meeting platform designed to provide flexible and interactive spaces for users. We believe that by combining creativity and technical expertise, Virtual Meet will make online meetings and communication easier and more efficient than ever before.

terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.subHeading: By using Virtual Meet, you agree to these Terms of Use. Please read them carefully.
terms.eligibility: You must be at least 13 years old to use this Platform. If under 18, you must have a guardian’s consent.
terms.account: To access features like creating rooms, posts, and following friends, you need to create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account.
terms.content: You own the content you post, but by uploading it, you grant us permission to use it on the Platform. Please avoid posting anything that violates laws or harms others.
terms.prohibitedUses: You cannot use the Platform for illegal activities, harassment, or sharing harmful content.
terms.termination: We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these Terms.
terms.changes: We may update these Terms. Check periodically for updates.
